msContents.summary: [p]Collection of thirteen alchemical treatises in German and Latin, mostly written by the hand of Gessler, and including at the end a copy of the Rosicrucian [i]Fama Fraternitatis[/i] in German.[p]Contents:[p]1. Montanor, Guido de. "Menstruum vegetabile [etc.]". At end, "Beendet des 1/11 Januarii anno 1610 zu Strassburg" (ff.1-52).[p]2. Ripley, George. "Medulla philosophiae ... de secretis alchimiae." At the end of this work, on folio 76, the date of composition is given as 1426. (ff.54-76)[p]3. "Aqua vitae ex M. Bartholomaeo [Anglico] in suo libro medicinae". (ff.76-77)[p]4."Tinctura a Domino Dufall ex libro Nicolai Flamelli et D.M. Jacobi [Teutonici?]"[p]5. Hyarcha, Franciscus. "Manuale". On f.111 "Actum 13/3 decembris Anno domini 1609". (ff.79-113)[p]6. Boliardus. "Opus ad faciendum medicinam penetrantem et fixam super 80 partes meercurii crudi ad lunam verissimam. Ex volumine a doctore Ione Adelwerti." (ff.113v-115)[p]ff. 115v-119 blank.[p]7. Gromis, Giacomo Antonio. "Secreta secretissima medicinae spagyricae ... J.A. de Gromis Marchionis, olim Paduae, 137 annos habentis: a D. Benedicto Figulo ex ipsius libro descripta. (ff.120-156)[p]8. Phaedro, Georg. "Flos Hermaphroditi sapphiricus. Cujus una pars in ter mille liquati ophirizi partes infusa, id omne in sui naturam convertit ... Nunc primum ... e tenebris eruta per Raphaelem Eglinum Iconium. M.D.CXII. (ff.156v-159)[p]9. Crell, Franz. "Operationes chemico-spagyricae. Sampt allerley Handgriffen, Notelen undt Cautelen ... Super opus Lapidis Philosophici vegetabile ... by Churfursten Ernesto laboririt. Anno [15]81, 82, 83, 84, 85, etc. Epistolae de cymica philosophia [etc.]. (ff.160-208). This work is written in a different hand from that of the other treatises.[p]10. Mardochai de Nelle. Wie man die Sulfur, Arsenik und Salz aus des Minerales sole zu Weges bringen. (ff.209-228)[p]11. Paracelsus [Bombastus ab Hohenheim] (A.P.T.) Gradationes ex Libro de gradationibus. (ff.228v-235)[p]12. Ein Tabella oder Taffel darinen der Anfang, das Mittel, und das End, als der rechte, war hafftige Gründ aller philosophischer Weisheit begrüffet ist. (ff.236-244).[p]13. Fama Fraternitatis oder Bruderschafft des hochlöblichen Ordens des fratris R[osen] C[reutzes]. Ahn die Heubter Stende, und Gelehrten Europae. (ff.245-265).[p]On folio 1, the compiler of this collection has written "Sum Joannis Gessleri Zabernensis, Sancti Petri Junioris Argentinensis Ecclesiae Canonicus, et Rector Ecclesiae Ottersweyrensis. 1612." As noted under Physical Description, the upper cover is stamped with the date 1610, and the treatises bear dates between 1609 and 1613.[p]Text written within red rules, title pages and headings in red, or red and green.[p]Pen drawings of alchemical apparatus on fols. 207v, 208 and 244.[p]On the fourth preliminary leaf is an inscription: "Christian Franz Schlökhel [?] No.12".
